Audio, subtitles & app controls

Open the player’s Audio & Subtitles menu to choose a supplied language track or subtitle. Available languages depend on the source. If a dub is missing, try subtitles or a different server inside the player.

Android fullscreen: swipe the left edge for brightness, the right edge for device volume. In the updated apps, double-tap left/right to go back/forward 10 seconds without leaving fullscreen. Android fullscreen opens sideways; press Back to leave fullscreen. On Windows, use the player’s fullscreen button or F11. Volume boost beyond the device maximum is not supported by this embedded player.

External player: Vidy. The external player may show ads, open pop-ups, or redirect. A listed title does not guarantee an available stream.

About Radha Movies

Title information and artwork come from public pages of The Movie Database (TMDB). This product is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Catalogue search and browsing depend on that external service.

Playback is embedded from Vidy using its published integration. Radha Movies does not host movie files. Availability, rights, audio languages and subtitles are not independently verified. The external player may display advertisements.

The external player runs with its standard permissions and may show ads or open other pages. Your watchlist and playback position are stored in this browser.
